ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity (off-white/beige) to 30% low-intensity (black) pixel distribution across the visible fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Low-intensity black pixels are concentrated along the central peduncle, the median notch border, and the continuous trailing edge margins. High-intensity pixels dominate the lobe interiors, featuring extensive beige/tan staining and off-white micro-mottling.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: V-shaped depression with an approximate pixel angle of 75 degrees and a vertical depth comprising roughly 18% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration pattern with frequent low-amplitude peaks and valleys along the trailing edge; higher-amplitude irregularities are visible near the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Composite curve exhibiting convexity at the proximal end near the notch transitioning to a concave sweep toward the outer tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Distinct dark circular pixel clusters located on the mid-right lobe; high-contrast white circular spots detected on the black central stalk region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two parallel, diagonal high-intensity linear disruptions detected on the upper-left lobe segment.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Brownish-red filamentous biological growth (bio-fouling) is visible adhering to the extreme lateral tips of both lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Extensive beige/yellowish pigment saturation over the white ventral areas; a single prominent dark circular spot is positioned near the base of the right lobe's white field.
